scoring_justification: The headline result is a deterministic fixed quantity (activity at given composition) for which the reference value can be extracted from the paper's graphs. A full recompute from raw integrals inside the checker would be heavy and sensitive to discretization; a tolerance-based comparison is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference activities for Na-K at 384 K and Al-Mg at 1073 K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Figures 2 (Na-K) and 3 (Al-Mg); activity values read at x=0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9 with a digital measurement tool.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Visual estimation from the published figure images; the tolerance of 0.05 was chosen to cover both measurement uncertainty and minor implementation differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly based on the paper's reported results.

outputs.description: Activity of Na in liquid Na-K alloy at 384 K. The checker compares each reported activity to a hidden gold value; absolute deviation ≤ 0.05 earns full credit, larger deviation earns partial credit.
Activity of Al in liquid Al-Mg alloy at 1073 K. The checker compares each reported activity to a hidden gold value; absolute deviation ≤ 0.05 earns full credit, larger deviation earns partial credit.

output_contract.notes: Only the Hubbard-Sham dielectric function is required. The agent must implement the full hard-sphere and pseudopotential formalism; no pre-computed parameters are provided.
